name: Nxtspace-Web
description: Nxtspace Web is a web-based 3D scene creation platform designed specifically for the architecture industry. Whether you have prior experience with 3D modeling or not, you can get started with ease.  With Nxtspace Web, you can quickly build 3D architectural scenes, meet your project needs efficiently, and easily create your own custom demos.

paragraphs: Nxtspace Web is a 3D scene-building tool for the architecture industry. Built entirely on web technologies, it runs directly in the browser with no installation required.

Whether you are an architect, interior designer, real-estate planner, or product demonstrator, you can get started with zero learning curve and quickly produce interactive, shareable 3D architectural scene demos.
features: Fast 2D floor plan drafting: walls / arc walls / doors & windows / regions, combined with smart snapping, clear-distance rulers, vertex editing, dimension annotations, and reference lines / reference images to…

Real-time 3D visualization: 2D drawings instantly generate a 3D scene, with three rendering styles — material / outline / material-and-outline — plus three quality levels, dollhouse mode, walk mode (with physics…
One-click exterior: draw a rectangle on the map to automatically generate a real-world buildings & roads exterior, synchronized across 2D and 3D.

Material system & asset library: drag-and-drop material tiling, flood-fill tiling, material-brush pick & paint; structural components plus a categorized indoor model library, with support for custom model import (GLB /…
Multi-user collaboration: LAN collaboration sessions allow multiple people to edit the same project simultaneously, with remote cursors visible in real time.
